cases.question: Berapa kejadian banjir di Indonesia pada 2024 menurut BNPB?
cases.expect: National flood events in 2024; cite BNPB and the resource, not a province table.

cases.question: Berapa total kejadian bencana di Aceh pada 2024?
cases.expect: All disaster types for Aceh in 2024; report the published count.

cases.question: Berapa banjir di Aceh pada 2024?
cases.expect: Explain that the reviewed BNPB tables do not provide type by province.

cases.question: Apakah kejadian bencana di Papua Tengah naik sejak 2010?
cases.expect: Withhold a cross-year trend because province boundaries are not validated.

cases.question: Apa gempa terbaru menurut BMKG?
cases.expect: Use the live latest earthquake feed and display its event and fetch times.

cases.question: Bagaimana prakiraan cuaca Kemayoran besok?
cases.expect: Use the verified Kemayoran adm4, identify the forecast production time, and avoid observed-weather claims.

cases.question: Apakah ada peringatan dini cuaca aktif untuk Jakarta?
cases.expect: Use current CAP warnings only, respect expiry, and show the feed or CAP link.

cases.question: Bandingkan angka BPS untuk Aceh pada 2024 dengan jumlah kejadian bencana BNPB pada tahun yang sama.
cases.expect: Ask for a specific BPS indicator if ambiguous; join only confirmed 2024 province codes and do not infer causality.

cases.question: Ada peringatan BMKG sekarang; bagaimana riwayat banjir nasional BNPB pada 2024?
cases.expect: Place current warnings beside history without treating either as a forecast of disaster occurrence.
